newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai fishing boat in collision, 10 crew missing.
newsitem.headline: Thai fishing boat in collision, 10 crew missing.

text.p: Ten crew members of a Thai fishing boat were missing and feared dead after their vessel was in a collosion on Wednesday with a China-registered cargo ship at the mouth of Bangkok's Chao Phya river, police said on Thursday.
Police said the Chinese cargo ship "Long He" and the fishing boat, carrying 18 crew, collided at the river mouth near Paknaam province on the eastern outskirts of Bangkok.
Eight of the crew of the fishing boat, which broke into two, had been rescued, police told Reuters.
"The accident happened more than 24 hours ago, so we presume that those 10 (missing) crew might be trapped in the wreckage of the fishing boat and died," a marine police source said.
Police said the skipper of the cargo ship was detained for further investigation of the incident. They were unable to provide details of the cargo ship's handlers in Thailand.
